presentation.title: What is Artisan Compétent? The platform that oversees your projects
presentation.intro: Artisan Compétent is a French web app dedicated to overseen connections between individuals and construction professionals.
presentation.accordeon_content:
Unlike a simple directory or a traditional platform, Artisan Compétent does not just display tradespeople.

The platform sets up a genuine digital oversight system for the project, protecting all at once:

  • clients,
  • honest tradespeople,
  • and the money tied to the works.

The goal is simple:

  • prevent abandoned projects,
  • limit scams,
  • avoid lost deposits,
  • and restore trust in the construction industry.

THE PROBLEM ARTISAN COMPÉTENT SOLVES

Today, finding a tradesperson has become easy.

But knowing who to trust has become extremely complicated.

On Google, social media or search engines:

  • anyone can appear first,
  • reviews can be fake or manipulated,
  • recommendations from people around you guarantee nothing,
  • and above all: no one really protects the client's money.

The result:

  • lost deposits,
  • abandoned projects,
  • overcharging,
  • disputes,
  • unreachable tradespeople,
  • clients left alone.

Artisan Compétent was created to solve this problem.

HOW DOES ARTISAN COMPÉTENT WORK?

1. Verified tradespeople

Professionals on the platform are checked before joining:

  • business registration (Kbis),
  • professional liability insurance,
  • insurance policies,
  • ten-year warranty when applicable.

The goal:
filter out problematic profiles before they can even work on the platform.

2. Digital project tracking

Everything goes through the platform:

  • quotes,
  • messages,
  • comments,
  • photos,
  • project tracking.

Every step can be documented.

The client and the professional can both add:

  • photos,
  • proof,
  • comments,
  • observations.

Everything becomes traceable.

3. The money is held in escrow

This is the heart of the system.

Unlike traditional methods:
the client does not pay the tradesperson directly.

The money is overseen via Stripe in an escrow account until the project is validated.

  • The tradesperson cannot disappear with the money before the works are finished.
  • And the client cannot abusively block the payment without justification either.

Artisan Compétent acts as a trusted third party and arbitrates in case of dispute based on the available evidence.

4. A digital project handover report

When the works are finished:
the professional sends a digital project handover report.

The client then has 48 hours to:

  • check the works,
  • report a problem,
  • request a correction if necessary.

This period strongly protects clients.

Because in the traditional system:
once paid, some tradespeople never come back.

With Artisan Compétent:
the funds remain overseen until final validation.

5. Overseen emergency call-outs

Artisan Compétent also offers emergency call-outs 24/7 for certain sensitive trades:

  • plumbing,
  • electricity,
  • locksmithing,
  • drain unblocking.

The goal:
avoid abuse, night-time overcharging and emergency scams.

6. A system also designed for honest tradespeople

Artisan Compétent doesn't only protect clients.

The platform also protects honest professionals:

  • against unpaid invoices,
  • against false disputes,
  • against malicious clients,
  • and against the poor image of the industry.

Honest tradespeople finally have a system that rewards seriousness and transparency.

CMOD: DIGITAL CLIENT PROJECT ADVISOR

Artisan Compétent also offers a unique service:
the CMOD.

The CMOD is an experienced construction professional who supports the client remotely.

Their role:

  • reassure,
  • explain,
  • help understand a quote,
  • advise during the project.

It is an optional add-on that brings even more peace of mind.

WHY ARTISAN COMPÉTENT IS DIFFERENT

Because the platform does not just sell contacts.

It creates a framework.

A digital oversight inspired by professional construction industry methods:

  • tracking,
  • proof,
  • arbitration,
  • traceability,
  • fund oversight.

Today:
Google can display a tradesperson.

But Google does not protect your money.

Search engines can recommend a professional.

But they do not track your project.

Artisan Compétent does.

FOR WHOM?

For individuals

Who want to:

  • avoid scams,
  • oversee their money,
  • find serious tradespeople,
  • track their works properly.

For honest tradespeople

Who want to:

  • work with serious clients,
  • be paid properly,
  • reassure their clients,
  • stand out from bad professionals.

For affiliates and partners

Who want to recommend a useful, concrete and overseen solution.

Recommending Artisan Compétent is completely different from recommending "a tradesperson we know".

Because the system itself is designed to prevent abuse.

ARTISAN COMPÉTENT'S MISSION

To gradually build a new standard of trust in construction.

A more transparent system.
More overseen.
More professional.

And above all:
a system where no one disappears with clients' money.

cmod.title: CMOD: Need some support?
cmod.body:
Not a building professional yourself and you'd like extra reassurance during your project?

The CMOD (Digital Client Project Advisor) is an experienced construction professional who supports you remotely by video call throughout your works.

Their role is not to replace the tradesperson, nor to visit the site, but to give you an independent professional perspective to help you better understand the various stages of the project, the technical discussions and the important decisions.

At Artisan Compétent, the professionals on the platform are already verified and the works are overseen through our digital tracking system, photo proof, traceability and fund oversight.

The CMOD is therefore an optional add-on for clients who want even more reassuring support, particularly for longer or more technical projects.

In the event of a disagreement or dispute with a tradesperson, and when no amicable solution could be found at first, a CMOD call can also be offered to help the parties better understand the situation and encourage a constructive resolution.

What the CMOD brings in practice

  • Remote support from an experienced construction professional.
  • An independent technical perspective during the project.
  • Less stress and more clarity about the works carried out.
  • A better understanding of quotes, stages and technical discussions.
  • Extra monitoring for longer or more complex projects.
  • Help with communication between the client and the tradesperson if needed.

CMOD support packages

  • 1-week project monitoring: €200
  • 2-week project monitoring: €300
  • 3-week project monitoring: €400
  • 4-week project monitoring: €500

Full project support: paid packages available depending on the duration and the needs of the project.
Call only in case of dispute.

escrow.title: Fund escrow: your protection against nasty surprises
escrow.body:
On many platforms, the client pays a deposit or the full amount directly to the tradesperson before the work is even finished.

At Artisan Compétent, it works in a completely different way.

When you accept a quote and make your payment via the platform, the funds are immediately secured in an escrow account managed by Stripe, a certified, internationally recognised payment provider.

In concrete terms, this means the money is neither in the tradesperson's account nor in Artisan Compétent's bank account.

Even Artisan Compétent's director cannot freely access, transfer or divert the funds.

The amounts stay held within Stripe's secure protocol until the project is validated or any dispute is resolved.

This system protects, at the same time:

  • the client,
  • the tradesperson,
  • and the funds tied to the work.

How does it work in practice?

You accept the quote and make the payment directly via the platform.

The funds are then placed in secure escrow.

Throughout the project, you can follow progress from your digital dashboard:

  • photos,
  • messages,
  • documents related to the project.

The professional can add tracking items, but you can also:

  • add your own observations,
  • report a problem if necessary.

Each item is time-stamped and archived to ensure complete traceability of the project.

Nothing can be deleted from the tracking once it has been recorded.

validation.title: Work validation and release of funds
validation.body:
Once the project is finished, the professional sends you a digital completion report.

You then have up to 48 hours to:

  • validate the report or raise a reservation if necessary.

During this period, the funds stay secured and are not paid to the professional.

If no problem is reported within the set period, the funds are released automatically in line with the conditions set out in the Terms of Use, and the report is deemed validated without reservation.

In the event of a dispute, the funds stay held while Artisan Compétent analyses the records in the digital tracking, to support arbitration based on concrete evidence.

klarna.title: Payment in instalments via Klarna
klarna.body:
For some quotes, payment in instalments can be offered via Klarna.

This option is not imposed by Artisan Compétent and depends entirely on the professional's choice.

Using Klarna does indeed involve additional fees, which are borne by the tradesperson.

The professional therefore remains free:

  • to offer payment in instalments,
  • or to decline this payment facility depending on their organisation and cash flow.

Artisan Compétent simply makes this technical feature available to tradespeople who wish to enable it.

By default, Artisan Compétent observes that most eligible clients generally have a financing limit of up to €1,500 via Klarna.

However, some clients may qualify for a higher limit depending on their profile and the conditions set directly by Klarna.

It is therefore up to the client to check directly with Klarna the exact amount they qualify for as well as the financing terms available.

The funds are never released before final validation of the project handover report, or resolution of the case in the event of a dispute.

malfacon.title: Notice a problem or a defect? Here's the right approach.
malfacon.body:
1. Talk to the tradesperson

The vast majority of situations are resolved simply through dialogue.

The tradespeople on Artisan Compétent are verified, serious professionals.

As on any project, a finish, an adjustment or a detail may sometimes need correcting after the work.

Before reporting anything, take the time to talk calmly with the professional in order to look for an amicable solution.

2. Report the problem from your client area

If, despite these discussions, no agreement is reached, you can report the problem directly from your dashboard.

From that point, the Artisan Compétent team can access all the digital tracking already present on the platform:

  • photos,
  • messages in the internal chat,
  • items added by the client and the professional.

The advantage of this approach is that it spares the parties from having to start over or resend everything.

As the project is already documented directly within the platform, the team can analyse the situation from the items already recorded and time-stamped.

Only in certain cases will additional information or items be requested, if this is needed to deepen the analysis.

Throughout this phase, the funds stay held in secure escrow.

3. Analysis of the situation and overseen mediation

In the event of a dispute, Artisan Compétent analyses the records in the digital tracking in order to encourage a balanced resolution based on concrete evidence.

It is important to point out that Artisan Compétent does not impose a price grid on the professionals on the platform.

Prices remain free.

Tradespeople set their own rates and quotes according to their experience, their structure, their geographic area and the nature of the work carried out.

The platform simply provides recommendations and best practices to encourage consistent and transparent practices.

Cases of clear abuse mainly concern certain particularly sensitive emergency call-outs, especially at night or in immediate repair situations.

In the rare cases where clearly excessive and entirely disproportionate overcharging is found compared with the practices usually observed for this type of call-out, Artisan Compétent may launch an enhanced mediation procedure in accordance with the Terms of Use and Terms of Sale.

Before any measure is taken, an attempt at an amicable resolution is always favoured with the professional concerned.

If no reasonable agreement is found despite the discussions and the analysis of the evidence, Artisan Compétent may:

  • temporarily suspend the professional's account,
  • or even permanently remove their access to the platform in the event of a serious breach.

In this context, a processing fee of up to €250 may be applied in accordance with the Terms of Use and Terms of Sale.

This fee is not kept by Artisan Compétent and is paid back to the client from the escrowed portion, in order to partly compensate for the harm suffered.

This type of situation nevertheless remains exceptional, as the vast majority of tradespeople on the platform are serious, good-faith professionals.

signed.title: And what if you've already signed the report?
signed.body:
Don't panic.

The tradespeople on Artisan Compétent remain bound by their professional obligations and by the legal warranties that apply to the work carried out.

Like any serious professional, they will step in if a legitimate correction is needed after the project has been handed over.

Depending on the nature of the work, various legal warranties then continue to apply:

  • the defects (snagging) warranty,
  • the two-year warranty when the work concerned requires it,
  • the ten-year warranty when the work concerned requires it.

Take the time to check. Your safety also depends on those checks.

fournitures.title: Fournitures et matériaux : un point essentiel souvent sous-estimé
fournitures.content:
The choice of supplies and materials plays a major role in the success of a project.

Beyond aesthetics, it can have a direct impact on:

  • the final quality of the works,
  • the durability of the installations,
  • warranties,
  • insurance,
  • and the handling of any future dispute.

This is why Artisan Compétent places particular importance on transparency and the choice of materials from the very start of the quote.

Why Artisan Compétent favours the professional's suppliers

In most cases, it is recommended to let the professional work with their usual suppliers.

An experienced tradesperson generally knows:

  • the materials they truly master,
  • the brands compatible with their working methods,
  • the products suited to the technical constraints of the project,
  • and the suppliers able to ensure consistent quality.

This approach often allows:

  • better project organisation,
  • fewer technical errors,
  • a smoother execution,
  • and easier handling of warranties and insurance.

Professionals also frequently enjoy advantageous conditions with their suppliers:

  • trade pricing,
  • faster availability,
  • or payment terms suited to their business.

This is one of the reasons why Artisan Compétent mainly focuses on projects that are reasonable in duration and organisation, in order to preserve a healthy balance for tradespeople and clients alike.

The platform is particularly suited to projects that are:

  • short or medium length,
  • clearly defined,
  • and starting within a coherent timeframe after the quote is validated.

Material choice and purchases made by the client

The client remains free to:

  • choose certain supplies,
  • require a specific brand,
  • select a specific material,
  • or buy certain equipment themselves.

This option remains fully allowed.

However, these choices must be reported to the professional before the quote is validated.

Why?

Because the materials used directly influence:

  • the quality of the final result,
  • the reliability of the installation,
  • long-term performance,
  • warranties,
  • and sometimes even the professional's insurance.

A serious tradesperson can therefore perfectly well refuse certain materials if they consider them to:

  • not meet the technical requirements of the project,
  • present a risk of poor long-term performance,
  • or risk engaging their future liability.

When certain supplies are bought directly by the client without being included in the escrowed quote, it becomes essential to keep as much transparency and traceability as possible.

All invoices and proof of purchase must be added to the project dashboard in order to allow:

  • clear tracking of the materials used,
  • a better understanding of the project,
  • preservation of useful items in case of future disagreement,
  • and full traceability of the equipment installed.

These documents may notably become important:

  • for warranties,
  • for insurance,
  • for compliance of the installations,
  • or to identify the source of a technical problem after the works.

Trade suppliers and DIY stores: very real differences

Not all materials offer the same level of quality, even when they look visually similar.

Depending on their origin or their range, differences may concern:

  • durability,
  • resistance,
  • performance,
  • or compatibility with certain installations.

Specialist construction suppliers generally offer products better suited to intensive professional use.

Conversely, some products sold in DIY stores are more intended for occasional or general public use.

This does not mean they are necessarily bad.

But in case of a technical problem or a dispute related to the quality of the materials, Artisan Compétent will be able to take into account:

  • the chosen supplier,
  • the purchase context,
  • and whether the professional validated these products or not.

When certain materials have been imposed against the professional's advice, this information will naturally be taken into account when analysing the case.

The most overseen approach for supplies

In most cases, Artisan Compétent recommends that supplies are included directly in the quote and managed by the professional through their usual suppliers.

This method generally remains the simplest and most overseen:

  • for project tracking,
  • for warranties,
  • for technical consistency,
  • and for overall liability for the works.

For quotes below €2,000, supplies must be managed directly by the professional and included in the quote.

This organisation generally allows:

  • a faster project,
  • better coordination,
  • fewer logistical errors,
  • and smoother handling of the project as a whole.

However, some larger or longer projects may require significant supply amounts.

In some situations, the professional's suppliers may also refuse to grant additional payment terms to the tradesperson, particularly when:

  • the amount of materials is high,
  • or when the funds are released too long after the final validation of the works.

It should also be kept in mind that some materials can sharply increase in price between the signing of the quote and the actual start of the project if orders are not placed quickly.

In these situations, it is understandable that a professional cannot advance the materials.

When this happens, it is preferable for the client to accompany the tradesperson directly to the supplier in order to pay for the materials on site.

This organisation allows:

  • oversight of the purchases,
  • immediate verification of the orders,
  • collection of the receipts,
  • and confirmation that the materials will indeed be delivered to the actual project address.

The client must then keep:

  • the invoices,
  • the order forms,
  • and any proof of delivery.

In this type of setup, the supplies paid for directly at the supplier do not appear in the quote escrowed via the platform, since they are settled separately.

However, all invoices must be added to the project's digital tracking in order to keep full traceability of the purchases and materials used, and also to keep a clear and usable history in case of future need.

This setup can also bring an economic advantage:

  • for the tradesperson, who then bears a smaller commission on the supplies portion.

Artisan Compétent advises against handing money directly to a professional without being present at the supplier or without clear proof.

Refurbished materials: Artisan Compétent's position

Artisan Compétent mainly favours the use of new materials.

Regarding equipment containing:

  • electronics,
  • gas,
  • or sensitive components,

the platform strongly advises against the use of refurbished equipment.

Why?

Because this equipment can engage:

  • the safety of the occupants,
  • warranties,
  • insurance,
  • and the professional's liability.

The professional remains free to accept this type of installation or not.

However, for materials containing neither electronics nor gas, Artisan Compétent remains open to certain refurbished or reused solutions when they remain technically coherent.

This may notably concern:

  • certain structural materials,
  • furniture,
  • decorative items,
  • or equipment without particular risk.

The goal is also to encourage, when possible, a more responsible and more environmentally friendly approach.

etape1.title: Sign-up, creating a work request, automatic broadcast of the request
etape1.body:
Sign-up is required in order to communicate with our tradespeople

From the dashboard or from the homepage, you:

  • select the trade you are looking for (plumber, electrician, mason, locksmith, etc.),
  • set the search radius you want around your area,
  • then browse the list of professionals matching your criteria.

A list of professionals compatible with your request is then proposed to you according to:

  • the trade you are looking for,
  • the geographic area,
  • availability,
  • and the criteria matching your need.

If no professional appears immediately, you can widen the search radius to increase the number of available results.

And if no tradesperson is yet available in your area for the requested trade, it simply means that the platform's deployment is still ongoing in that zone.

Artisan Compétent's goal is to gradually cover all of France, Corsica and the French overseas territories with a network of qualified professionals.

Once the list is displayed, you choose yourself the professionals you wish to contact. This approach prevents too many tradespeople from receiving the same request simultaneously and ensures more targeted, more serious and more efficient exchanges.

Once the professionals are selected, you can then explain your need via:

  • photos,
  • or a descriptive text.

This step only takes a few seconds.

Overseen exchanges and integrated video call

The professionals you have selected then receive your request directly in their professional area. Exchanges then take place via the platform's overseen internal chat.

No personal contact details are shared:

  • no phone number,
  • no email address,
  • no personal address.

If photos and written explanations are not enough, the client and the professional can also make a video call directly via the platform, without sharing contact details.

This allows you:

  • to better explain the need,
  • to show the problem live,
  • to avoid certain unnecessary visits,
  • and to give the professional as much information as possible before drawing up the quote.

All selected respondents receive the request simultaneously, ensuring transparency and fair competition.

etape2.title: Receiving quotes, validating the project and overseeing payments
etape2.body:
Receiving, comparing and verifying quotes

The selected and interested professionals must submit their quotes directly via the platform.

You can then:

  • compare offers,
  • ask your questions,
  • review profiles,
  • review ratings,
  • check the professional's insurance and certifications.

Even though Artisan Compétent already performs checks before tradespeople join the platform, the client remains responsible for verifying that the professional's insurance, certifications and warranties are still valid at the time the quote is signed.

Why? Because between the first check performed by the platform and the date of the project:

  • an insurance policy may have expired,
  • a certification may have been suspended,
  • or certain works may no longer be covered.

This verification is therefore an important step to ensure that the professional is properly insured for the works planned in the quote. You remain free and responsible for your choice.

Quote validation and project start

Once the professional is selected and both parties agree on the conditions:

  • the quote is signed directly on the platform,
  • the conditions are locked,
  • the project can start.

All exchanges, validations and documents remain centralised in the project's digital tracking.

Overseen payment and fund escrow via Stripe

Payment is made directly via the Artisan Compétent platform thanks to the overseen Stripe system.

Depending on the amounts and the situation, payment can be made:

  • by bank card,
  • or by bank transfer.

The funds are then placed in an overseen escrow account via Stripe until the project is finally validated. The money is never paid directly into Artisan Compétent's bank account.

The platform's role is solely to oversee, protect and arbitrate if necessary based on the items present in the digital tracking. Even Artisan Compétent's director cannot divert the escrowed funds, since they remain in the overseen Stripe protocol until they are released to the professional or partly or fully returned to the client depending on the situation.

Supplies and materials: recommended approach and oversight of purchases

In most situations, Artisan Compétent recommends that supplies are included directly in the quote and managed by the professional through their usual suppliers.

This method generally remains the simplest and most overseen:

  • for project tracking,
  • for warranties,
  • for technical consistency,
  • and for overall liability for the works.

Professionals generally know:

  • the materials they truly master,
  • the brands compatible with their working methods,
  • and the suppliers able to ensure consistent quality.

For quotes below €2,000 (quotes including labour and supplies), the materials must be advanced by the professional and included directly in the quote.

This organisation generally allows:

  • a faster project,
  • better coordination,
  • fewer logistical errors,
  • and smoother handling of the project as a whole.

However, some larger or longer projects may require significant supply amounts.

In some situations, the professional's suppliers may also refuse to grant additional payment terms to the tradesperson, particularly when:

  • the amount of materials is high,
  • or when the funds are released too long after the final validation of the works.

It should also be kept in mind that some materials can sharply increase in price between the signing of the quote and the actual start of the project if orders are not placed quickly.

In these situations, it is understandable that a professional cannot advance the materials. The client and the tradesperson can then agree together on a direct payment of the materials at the supplier.

In this case:

  • the client accompanies the tradesperson to the supplier,
  • pays the supplies directly,
  • or pays the tradesperson directly on site in front of the supplier when the tradesperson benefits from more favourable trade pricing and the supplier requires this procedure.

This organisation allows:

  • oversight of the purchases,
  • immediate verification of the orders,
  • collection of the receipts,
  • confirmation that the materials will indeed be delivered to the actual project address,
  • avoiding lost deposits,
  • and keeping better traceability of expenses.

The client must then keep:

  • the invoices,
  • the order forms,
  • and any proof of delivery.

In this type of setup, the supplies paid for directly at the supplier do not appear in the quote escrowed via the platform, since they are settled separately. However, all invoices must be added to the project's digital tracking in order to keep full traceability of the purchases and materials used, and also to keep a clear and usable history in case of future need.

This setup can also bring an economic advantage for the tradesperson, who then bears a smaller commission on the supplies portion.

Artisan Compétent strongly advises against handing money directly to a professional without being present at the supplier or without clear proof.

Labour overseen via the platform

Labour payment must always be settled in full, regardless of the amount, via the overseen Stripe system integrated into the platform.

The funds remain held until validation of the project handover report or resolution of any dispute.

This approach allows:

  • to protect the client against abandoned projects,
  • to protect the tradesperson against abusive non-payment,
  • and to create a clear, protected and transparent framework for both parties.

Payment in instalments via Klarna

Depending on the amounts and only if the professional accepts it, a payment-in-instalments solution via Klarna can be offered.

This payment facility is not imposed by Artisan Compétent. It remains the professional's choice, since the fees related to Klarna are borne according to the conditions agreed between the platform and the tradesperson.

By default, Artisan Compétent observes that most eligible clients generally have a financing limit of up to around €1,500 via Klarna. However, some clients may qualify for a higher limit depending on their profile and the conditions set directly by Klarna.

It is therefore up to the client to check directly with Klarna the exact amount they qualify for as well as the financing terms available.

The funds are never released before the final validation of the project handover report or resolution of the case in the event of a dispute.

etape3.title: Project start and tracking, reporting and CMOD intervention
etape3.body:
Project start and tracking

Once the quote is signed and the overseen payment made via the platform, the project can start.

Throughout the duration of the works:

  • the professional is required to regularly add tracking photos and comments to the platform,
  • every important stage of the project must be documentable,
  • exchanges remain centralised in the project's digital tracking,
  • the client follows progress directly from their dashboard.

The client remains the project owner. As such, it is also up to them to follow the works, regularly review the items added by the professional and quickly report any issue likely to compromise the proper execution or proper handover of the works.

The sooner a problem is reported, the easier it is to correct quickly and under good conditions.

For fast or emergency call-outs, particularly repairs performed within a very short timeframe, a simple condition photo accompanied by an explanatory comment from the professional may be enough.

If no particular issue is noted, the client is not required to add comments or contradicting items in the tracking.

Every step remains traced, time-stamped and centralised in the platform in order to ensure transparent tracking accessible to both parties.

Reporting a problem during the project

In case of disagreement, of an observed defect or of difficulty during the project, the client and the professional are encouraged to favour dialogue first and an attempt at an amicable arrangement.

The vast majority of situations are resolved directly between the parties when they communicate quickly and constructively.

If no agreement is reached, the client can then file a report directly from their dashboard. The Artisan Compétent team then has access to all the items already present in the digital tracking:

  • internal chat exchanges,
  • photos,
  • comments,
  • documents,
  • quotes,
  • project stages.

In most cases, these items already allow a first analysis of the situation without any additional document being requested immediately.

CMOD intervention in case of dispute

In case of a dispute that persists despite attempts at communication between the parties, Artisan Compétent can propose a call with a CMOD (Digital Client Project Advisor).

The CMOD is an independent construction professional with field experience.

Their role is:

  • to help clarify the situation,
  • to ease the exchanges,
  • to bring an external technical perspective,
  • and to encourage a middle ground between the client and the professional.

This support is provided exclusively remotely. The CMOD does not physically visit project sites.

If, despite this intervention, no agreement is reached, the case can then be escalated to the Artisan Compétent team for arbitration.

Arbitration is carried out based on the items present in the project's digital tracking, the recorded exchanges and the available evidence.

Artisan Compétent then makes a decision aimed at protecting the party considered to have been harmed in light of the items analysed and the obligations set out in the platform's Terms of Use and Terms of Sale.

etape4.title: Project handover, release of funds, reviews and project closure
etape4.body:
Project handover

At the end of the project, the professional sends a digital project handover report directly via the Artisan Compétent platform.

From that moment, the client has up to 48 hours to:

  • check the works carried out,
  • inspect the finishes,
  • report any defect,
  • request a correction if necessary,
  • or definitively validate the project.

The client can also validate the handover report immediately if they consider the works compliant.

Throughout this period, the funds remain overseen in the Stripe escrow account.

Eight hours before the end of the 48-hour period, an automatic reminder email is sent to the client. This email also serves as a formal notice, informing the client that:

  • either they must raise a reservation or a report if they notice a problem,
  • or the funds will be automatically released at the end of the set period.

If no reservation or challenge is raised within the set period, the handover report is automatically deemed validated in accordance with the platform's Terms of Use and Terms of Sale.

Funds release

Once the handover report is validated, manually or automatically after expiry of the set period without reservation, the escrowed funds are immediately released to the professional.

The funds never pass through Artisan Compétent's bank account. They remain overseen in the Stripe protocol until their final release.

In case of reservation, reported defect or declared dispute within the set period:

  • the funds remain held,
  • an analysis of the case can be performed,
  • an amicable exchange is favoured,
  • and arbitration can be initiated if necessary based on the items recorded in the digital tracking.

Depending on the situation:

  • a correction can be requested,
  • a partial refund can be made,
  • or the funds can be adjusted proportionally to the works actually carried out.

After handover: warranties and follow-up

Even after validation of the handover report, the professionals on Artisan Compétent remain bound by their legal obligations.

Like any serious construction professional, they remain required to step in for issues falling under:

  • the defects (snagging) warranty,
  • the two-year warranty when applicable,
  • or the ten-year warranty depending on the nature of the works carried out.

The Artisan Compétent system does not replace the existing legal warranties, but adds an extra layer of safety and traceability throughout the project.

Reviews and project closure

Once the project is finished, the client can leave a review on the professional.

Reviews are intended to remain:

  • transparent,
  • constructive,
  • useful to the community,
  • and based on a real experience lived via the platform.

Artisan Compétent's goal is not to create a simple review platform, but a trust environment based on projects actually tracked and documented.

Once the handover report is validated, Artisan Compétent also invites the client and the professional to download and keep all the documents, exchanges, photos, quotes, handover reports and items present in their dashboard.

These documents can be useful later in case of:

  • a warranty to be invoked,
  • a defect appearing after handover,
  • a future dispute,
  • or simply to keep a full history of the project.

The Artisan Compétent platform keeps the data for a limited period in accordance with its data management and protection policy. It is therefore up to the client and the professional to keep their own copies of the important items of the project.

Once this step is complete, the project is officially closed on the platform.

q2.question: What is the CMOD?
q2.summary: The CMOD (Digital Client Project Advisor) is a construction professional who supports the client remotely by video call during the project. They help with understanding technical situations and make dialogue between the parties easier. Monitoring packages are available depending on the length of the project, and a CMOD call can also be offered in the event of a dispute.
q2.body:
The CMOD (Digital Client Project Advisor) is an experienced construction professional who can support the client remotely during the project.

Their role is to:

  • help with better understanding certain technical situations,
  • and make dialogue between the parties easier when needed.

The support is provided remotely by video call, without any site visit.

Monitoring packages are available depending on the length of the project.

q3.question: Can I pay in instalments?

The financing is free of charge for the client when Klarna approves it, under the conditions offered at the time of payment.
q3.body:
Yes, a payment-in-instalments option via Klarna can be offered directly on the platform.

This option is optional and depends on:

The financing is free of charge for the client when it is approved by Klarna, under the conditions offered at the time of payment.

q4.question: Does Artisan Compétent operate everywhere in France?
q4.summary: Artisan Compétent is in a gradual rollout across mainland France, Corsica and the overseas territories. The platform already covers several cities and keeps expanding. If your area isn't served yet, you can encourage local tradespeople to join the platform, or become an affiliate to earn income on signed quotes.
q4.body:
The platform is in a gradual rollout phase.

Artisan Compétent already covers several French cities and keeps developing throughout mainland France, Corsica and the overseas territories.

The long-term goal is to offer a national network able to cover both large cities and more rural areas.

If your area isn't covered yet, it simply means the platform is still being developed in your zone.

You can also encourage serious tradespeople in your region to join the platform: the more there are, the faster and more effective the local coverage will be.

And if you'd like to take part in the development of Artisan Compétent, you can also join our affiliate programme.

Affiliates can recommend the platform to both clients and tradespeople and earn income on quotes signed through their recommendations.

Depending on the case and the campaigns running, this income can be paid for several months and up to a year for some profiles brought to the platform.

This makes it possible to:

  • grow a community of trust in the construction industry,
  • and let affiliates generate extra income by recommending a useful and secure solution.

q5.question: What should I do if I disagree with the quote or the work delivered?
q5.summary: First, favour talking it through with the tradesperson: most situations are settled amicably. For abusive quotes in emergencies or at night, you can report it from your dashboard within 48h. During the analysis, the funds stay in escrow and amicable mediation is favoured before any measure is taken.
q5.body:
The first thing to do is talk it through directly with the tradesperson.

The vast majority of situations are settled amicably. A serious tradesperson will agree to discuss it, explain a technical point, or come back to fix a finish if needed.

It is strongly advised to take the time for that discussion before reporting anything.

Regarding quotes considered abusive, Artisan Compétent only steps in in certain very specific cases of immediate or night-time emergencies, when the client doesn't really have time to compare prices or step back before accepting.

If clearly excessive abuse is found on this type of call-out, a report can be made from the client dashboard within 48 hours after the end of the work.

During this period:

  • the funds stay held in escrow,
  • the case can be analysed,
  • and amicable mediation is favoured.

If clear abuse is confirmed and the professional persistently refuses to find an amicable solution, Artisan Compétent may apply the measures set out in its Terms of Use and Terms of Sale, which can go as far as:

  • suspending or removing the professional's account,
  • applying a suspension processing fee of up to a set amount.

This fee can be taken directly from the escrowed amount when the abuse is clearly established, and is paid back to the client concerned in line with the way the platform works.

This mechanism remains exceptional and mainly concerns the rare situations of very significant abuse on emergency call-outs.

For standard projects and non-urgent quotes, prices remain free.

The client generally has the time needed to compare several quotes, ask their questions and accept or decline the proposal before signing.

q6.question: What happens if I don't validate the completion report within 48h?
q6.summary: After the project completion report is sent, you have 48 hours to validate it, contest it or report a problem. A reminder email is sent 8 hours before the deadline. If you take no action within the 48h, the report is validated automatically and the funds are released to the professional.
q6.body:
Once the project completion report is sent by the professional, the funds stay held in escrow for a period of up to 48 hours.

This period allows the client:

  • to check the work carried out,
  • or to request a correction if necessary.

Eight hours before the deadline, an automatic reminder email is sent to the client to remind them that they must either validate the report or report any problem before the deadline expires.

If no reservation, challenge or report is made within the 48 hours, the report is automatically deemed validated in accordance with the platform's Terms of Use and Terms of Sale.

The escrowed funds are then released automatically to the professional.

Once the report is validated, the construction industry's legal warranties of course remain applicable depending on the nature of the work carried out:

  • the defects (snagging) warranty,
  • the two-year warranty,
  • or the ten-year warranty when it is required.

q7.question: What happens if the work is done badly?
q7.summary: First, talk to the tradesperson: most defects are settled quickly through dialogue. If the problem persists, don't validate the report and report it from your dashboard within 48h; the funds stay in escrow. A discussion with a CMOD can be arranged, and the legal warranties (defects, two-year, ten-year) then apply depending on the work.
q7.body:
The first step is always to discuss it directly with the tradesperson.

Most defects or finishing problems are settled quickly when they're reported properly.

If the problem persists:

  • do not validate the project completion report,
  • report the situation from your dashboard within 48h,
  • and explain precisely the problem encountered.

During this period, the funds stay held in escrow.

The Artisan Compétent team can then analyse the situation from the digital tracking already present on the platform:

  • photos,
  • messages,
  • and items submitted during the work.

If necessary, a discussion with a CMOD (Digital Client Project Advisor) can also be arranged to help better understand the situation and encourage an amicable resolution.

If the report has already been signed, the serious tradespeople on the platform are still required to step in to correct any defect that falls under their responsibility.

And in any case, the legal warranties then continue to apply depending on the work carried out:

  • the defects (snagging) warranty,
  • the two-year warranty,
  • or the ten-year warranty.

q8.question: How can I avoid scams when looking for a tradesperson?
q8.summary: The best way to avoid scams is to never send money directly to a tradesperson without oversight or tracking. On Artisan Compétent, professionals are verified, communication is centralised, the work is tracked step by step and the funds stay in escrow via Stripe until validation. The system protects you even if the professional runs into financial difficulty or closes their business.
q8.body:
The best way to avoid scams is to never send money directly to a tradesperson without oversight or tracking.

With Artisan Compétent:

  • professionals are verified before joining,
  • communication is centralised,
  • the work is tracked step by step,
  • and the funds stay secured in escrow until the project is validated.

The system was designed to limit:

  • abandoned projects,
  • overcharged call-outs,
  • and situations where a tradesperson disappears after payment.

Even in the event of a life accident, financial difficulty or closure of the professional's business, the funds escrowed via Stripe stay protected within the secure payment protocol as long as they have not been released.

q9.question: How much does a plumber, an electrician or a locksmith cost on Artisan Compétent?
q9.summary: Prices depend on the trade, the type of call-out, the materials, the geographic area and the time of the service. Each tradesperson sets their own rates freely and presents their quote directly via the platform. To compare several proposals and learn the usual price ranges for your need, see the dedicated page for each trade.
q9.body:
On Artisan Compétent, prices are not set by the platform. Each tradesperson sets their own rates freely and presents their quote directly via their professional area.

Several factors influence the price of a call-out:

  • the trade involved (plumber, electrician, locksmith, heating engineer, drain unblocker, etc.),
  • the nature of the work (repair, installation, renovation),
  • the materials needed,
  • the geographic area of the call-out,
  • whether or not the request is urgent,
  • and the time of the call-out (day, night, weekend, public holidays).

To get an idea of the orders of magnitude and the usual price ranges for your need, see the dedicated page for each trade on the platform.

Our advice: always ask for several quotes before signing, compare the detailed services and don't hesitate to ask the tradesperson for clarification via Artisan Compétent's secure internal chat.

q10.question: What is the difference between Artisan Compétent and a standard matchmaking platform?
q10.summary: Unlike standard platforms that only do matchmaking, Artisan Compétent oversees the whole service: tradespeople verified before joining, payment escrowed via Stripe until the project is validated, time-stamped digital tracking, mediation available in the event of a dispute. The money never passes directly to the tradesperson or to Artisan Compétent.
q10.body:
Most construction platforms only connect a client with a tradesperson. Once the connection is made, the client is left alone with the professional to handle payment, project tracking and any disputes.

Artisan Compétent works differently:

  • tradespeople are verified before joining (business registration, insurance, certifications),
  • communication goes through the secure internal chat,
  • payment is escrowed via Stripe until the project is validated,
  • every step is time-stamped and archived in the digital tracking,
  • mediation is available in the event of a dispute, based on the recorded evidence.

The money never passes directly to the tradesperson, nor even into Artisan Compétent's bank account. The funds stay within Stripe's secure protocol until they are released to the professional or returned to the client depending on the situation.

This complete framework aims to protect both honest clients and serious tradespeople, and to restore trust in the construction sector.

q11.question: How can I find a good plumber, electrician or locksmith near me?
q11.summary: On Artisan Compétent, enter your address, select the trade you're looking for and set a call-out radius. The platform shows the verified tradespeople available in your area, with their certifications, insurance and reviews. You choose who to contact, compare quotes, and payment stays overseen until the work is validated.
q11.body:
Finding a good tradesperson is, above all, finding a professional who is verified, serious and suited to your specific need.

On Artisan Compétent, the search takes just a few steps:

  • enter your address from the homepage or your dashboard,
  • select the trade you're looking for (plumber, electrician, locksmith, heating engineer, etc.),
  • set the search radius around your area,
  • review the list of professionals matching your criteria.

For each tradesperson shown, you can access:

  • the checks carried out (business registration, insurance, certifications),
  • the reviews left by previous clients who completed a project via the platform,
  • and the option to start a conversation via the secure internal chat.

You choose for yourself which professionals to contact, you compare the quotes received, and you sign with full knowledge of the facts. Payment stays overseen until validation of the project completion report.

q12.question: How does Klarna instalment payment work on Artisan Compétent?
q12.summary: Klarna lets you pay in instalments on Artisan Compétent. The option is only offered if the professional accepts it (the Klarna fees are borne by them) and if you are eligible under Klarna's conditions. The observed limit is generally €1,500, sometimes higher depending on your profile. The eligibility check is carried out at the time of payment.
q12.body:
Artisan Compétent makes the Klarna payment solution available so that clients can spread the payment of a quote over several instalments.

This option works under three conditions:

  • the professional's acceptance, since the Klarna fees are borne entirely by the tradesperson who enables this option,
  • your financing eligibility, determined solely by Klarna based on your profile,
  • the conditions offered by Klarna at the time of payment.

By default, Artisan Compétent observes that most eligible clients generally have a financing limit of up to €1,500 via Klarna. Some clients may qualify for a higher limit depending on their profile and the conditions set directly by Klarna.

It is up to each client to check with Klarna:

  • the exact amount they qualify for,
  • the financing terms available,
  • and any fees or interest applicable depending on their situation.

The financing is free of charge for the client when Klarna approves the application under the conditions offered at the time of payment. The funds paid via Klarna stay overseen within Stripe escrow until final validation of the project, just like any other payment method.

q13.question: What should I do in an emergency: water leak, heating breakdown, slammed door?
q13.summary: Artisan Compétent gives you access to emergency tradespeople 24/7 for plumbing, heating, locksmithing, electricity and drain unblocking. Even in an emergency, fund escrow applies: you only release the payment once the call-out is finished, and the 48-hour rule to react still applies. See the page for each emergency trade for the details.
q13.body:
Emergencies don't wait. Water leak, heating breakdown, slammed door, power cut, blocked pipe: Artisan Compétent gives you access to emergency tradespeople available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

The 5 emergency trades covered:

  • Emergency plumber (leak, water damage),
  • Emergency heating engineer (boiler breakdown, no heating),
  • Emergency locksmith (slammed door, broken lock),
  • Emergency electrician (power cut, short circuit),
  • Emergency drain unblocker (blocked pipe, backflow).

Even in an emergency, the platform's framework applies:

  • communication goes through the platform,
  • Stripe fund escrow still applies,
  • you only release the payment once the call-out is finished,
  • you have 48 hours to react, raise a reservation or contest the report.

It is precisely in emergency situations that night-time overcharging and clearly excessive pricing abuse are most common. Artisan Compétent's arbitration system is calibrated to handle these situations as a priority.

For each emergency trade, a dedicated page details the call-outs covered, the response times and the precautions to know before accepting a quote. See the page for the relevant trade for more details.

affiliation.question: How does the Artisan Compétent affiliate program work?
affiliation.summary: Free sign-up, no audience size requirement. You earn up to 25% commission on the Artisan Compétent margin when your referral signs their project handover report: 20% in the first year on the client side, 5% per tradesperson referred for 6 months. One rule only to stay active: publish at least one piece of content per week.
affiliation.body:
Sign up for free in 2 minutes, with no audience size requirement, and receive a unique affiliate link tied to your partner account to track your referrals.

You earn up to 25% commission on the Artisan Compétent margin: 20% in the first 6 months after a client signs up (then 10% for the next 6 months) and 5% per tradesperson referred for 6 months.

Commissions are validated once the project handover report is signed, then paid by quarterly bank transfer with a PDF receipt available in your partner area.

One rule only to stay active: publish at least one piece of content per week. Without publishing for 14 days, your link is deactivated, but referrals already tied to your account continue to generate commissions.

In a few seconds, you describe your problem via audio, video or photo, and our solution connects you directly with qualified electricians near you — whether for a standard installation or smart home devices and home automation.

whenToCall.title: When to call a verified electrician
whenToCall.lead: A verified electrician handles breakdowns, electrical panels, NF C 15-100 compliance upgrades, NF C 18-510 electrical certification, home automation and IRVE EV charging stations. Emergencies cover general power outages and recurring short circuits.
whenToCall.body: Electricians listed on Artisan Compétent handle rapid troubleshooting, compliance upgrades and full renovations. Typical cases that justify calling a verified professional rather than a DIYer:
items: General or partial power outage, main circuit breaker that won't reset
Recurring short circuit, overheating outlet, burning smell near a lighting point
Replacement or full renovation of the electrical panel with 30 mA RCDs
NF C 15-100 compliance upgrade on an older installation (earth bonding, isolation, differential devices)
NF C 18-510 electrical certification for any live work: legally mandatory
Additional outlets, lighting points, switches, two-way switches
Home automation installation: centralised control of lighting, blinds, heating, scenes, voice integration
IRVE EV charging station installation with specific qualification required (Qualifelec IRVE) and Consuel declaration
Full electrical diagnostic before sale, rental or home insurance subscription
whenToCall.footer: All these interventions engage the electrician's ten-year liability on durable installations. NF C 18-510 certification is mandatory for any live work. IRVE qualification is mandatory for charging stations above 3.7 kW. This is why verifying the professional before signing the quote is essential.

whyUs.title: Why use Artisan Compétent for your electrical work
whyUs.lead: Artisan Compétent verifies the electrician upfront, manages your payment via Stripe escrow and gives you 48h to validate the job before any funds are released.

blocks.title: Every electrician listed on Artisan Compétent has their SIRET checked against public databases (Business Directory, INSEE/SIRENE) and their insurance verified before account validation on the platform.
blocks.body: Verification covers three elements: active SIRET, RC pro insurance certificate covering electrical work, mandatory decennial insurance on durable electrical installations. NF C 18-510 certification is required for live work. Qualifelec certification, when held, is highlighted on the professional's profile. IRVE qualification is required for EV charging stations. An electrician with missing or expired documents is not validated on Artisan Compétent. Once the quote is signed, the professional must upload their legal documents (insurance certificates, NF C 18-510 certification, IRVE qualification if applicable) to their dashboard. These documents are viewable by the client in their personal space. The client is invited to re-check sensitive documents beforehand, notably the electrical certification and IRVE certificate for EV charger installation as well as insurance.

blocks.title: The escrow account is a third-party account managed via Stripe that governs the entire process, from quote to fund release.
blocks.body: Payment leaves your account when you approve the electrician's quote, but remains held in a Stripe escrow account. Funds are released to the professional 48h after job completion, without dispute.

blocks.title: The 48h countdown is structured: reception report, defect window, end-of-deadline notification.
blocks.body: In practice, the 48h period doesn't run in a vacuum. At the end of the job, a reception report is issued on the platform. This report opens the 48h window during which you can raise defects: identified fault, non-conformity with the quote, missing finish, promised document not provided. 8h before the deadline, an email notification (acting as a formal notice to inspect the work) is sent to you to prevent a release simply due to oversight. Without defects raised within 48h, funds are automatically released to the professional. With defects, the escrow remains active until the dispute is resolved.

blocks.title: CMOD is a paid optional service providing remote project management support. Two complimentary calls offered under specific conditions.
blocks.body: CMOD (Digital Project Management Advisor) is a paid optional service. Two complimentary call options exist, activated only in the event of a reported dispute after a failed amicable resolution with the professional.

pricing.title: How much does electrical repair or renovation cost
pricing.lead: No reliable fixed price exists in electrical work: only a detailed quote from a verified electrician commits the professional to the real cost of an intervention. An indicative hourly range remains to be confirmed by Artisan Compétent and will be added in a future update.
pricing.body: The cost of electrical work depends on five cumulative variables. The elements that affect the quote:
items: The nature of the job (simple repair, adding electrical points, panel renovation, full compliance upgrade, EV charging station)
Urgency: standard hours, night, weekend or public holiday

items.q: What is the difference between a safety remediation and a full compliance upgrade?
items.a: Safety remediation covers the strictly necessary points to avoid immediate danger (30 mA differential protection on sensitive circuits, earth bonding, isolation). items.q: Is Consuel approval always required after electrical work?
items.a: Consuel approval is mandatory for any new installation or major renovation involving a new connection or significant panel overhaul. items.a: NF C 18-510 is the French standard governing operations on electrical systems. It defines certification levels (B0, B1V, B2V, BR, BC, etc.) by intervention type (dead work, live work, low voltage, high voltage, isolation). Any electrician working live must hold the corresponding certification level. On Artisan Compétent, certification is verified upfront and stored in the professional's dashboard.

commissions.condition1: Attribution cookie valid for 15 days after the first click on your link. It renews with every new click from a visitor via your link. So in practice, as long as you publish regularly, the cookie stays active.
commissions.condition2: On top of the cookie, your referral is tied to your partner account at signup. You earn commissions for the 12 months following their signup (3 months for any referred professional).
commissions.condition3: You must publish at least one piece of content per week to stay active. After 7 days without publication, you receive a warning. After 14 days, your link is deactivated. All referrals already tied to your account keep generating commissions normally.
commissions.condition4: Commissions only apply to Artisan Compétent's margin. Never on materials, never on the labor billed by the professional.
commissions.condition5: Quarterly bank transfer, starting from the handover certificate signed by the client. No payment on signed quote alone, because a quote can still be cancelled mid-job.

whyRecommend.title: You're not selling a product. You're selling protection. And you're building your brand.
whyRecommend.intro: Recommending Artisan Compétent isn't pushing yet another offer. It's telling your audience: here's how to put an end to inflated quotes, vanishing professionals, and botched jobs that you have to pay for anyway. Whether for a major renovation project or an emergency intervention of one or two days, the platform covers the full range.
whyRecommend.arg1: Escrow protection: the client's money is only released to the professional after the work is validated. That speaks to everyone.
whyRecommend.arg2: Professionals are verified (business registration, public liability insurance, ten-year warranty). No shady profiles.
whyRecommend.arg3: The CMOD service is an option to better oversee the job. For quotes between €2,000 and €5,000, a first 20-minute call is free. For quotes above €5,000, it's a 45-minute call.
whyRecommend.arg4: Signup is free for both clients and professionals. No barrier to entry.
whyRecommend.arg5: Klarna's split payment is available up to €1,500 on quotes, for both major projects and emergency interventions. Subject to the professional accepting to cover the fees (4.9% of the total quote).
whyRecommend.outro: If your audience includes homeowners, renters who want to renovate, condo owners, or simply people who are afraid of getting ripped off on a job, you have a natural audience for Artisan Compétent.

brandFomo.title: An opportunity not to miss.
brandFomo.body1: Recommending Artisan Compétent positions you as a trusted creator. Other brands see this as a signal of reliability, which can open up new partnership opportunities.
brandFomo.body2: And let's be lucid: you don't own your audience. The people who follow you also follow other creators. If you don't recommend Artisan Compétent today, someone else will tomorrow. And they'll be the ones earning the commission.
brandFomo.analogyTitle: An analogy to see the stakes
brandFomo.analogy: Imagine you own a 100,000 m² plot of land. Your neighbors each have 100 m² adjacent to yours. An oil company comes to you: there's oil under your land, we'll extract it and pay you a percentage. You refuse because you want more. The company simply goes to your neighbors, installs its rigs, and extracts the same oil. You missed the opportunity. Your audience works exactly the same way.

expectations.title: No magic, no promises. Just consistency.
expectations.exp1: At least one publication per week mentioning Artisan Compétent: video, post, story, podcast, or article.
expectations.exp2: One proof to add each week in your partner dashboard (direct link to your publication). Takes 30 seconds: copy the link to your post, paste it in the dedicated field, done.
expectations.exp3: Respect for the legal framework: no lying about what the platform is, no overselling what it does. Transparency is our hallmark, and we expect the same from our partners.
expectations.exp4: Normal use of your link: no spam, no purchase of unqualified traffic, no cookie fraud. Any manipulation triggers immediate suspension without notice.
expectations.note: We don't ask for minimum numbers, no KPI to hit. The only rule is consistency. If you publish every week, you stay in the program, whether you make 2 signups or 200.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need a large audience to join the program?
faq.a1: No. The program is open to everyone, no minimum threshold. A friend who tells 5 people about Artisan Compétent can generate a commission. We prefer 100 active and consistent partners over 10 large passive audiences.
faq.q2: When do I get my commission?
faq.a2: When the job is finished. Concretely: your referral signs their quote, the work is done, they sign the handover certificate, and that's when your commission is validated. Payment is quarterly by bank transfer.
faq.q3: Why not when the quote is signed?
faq.a3: Because a quote can still be cancelled mid-job (issue, accident, disagreement), in which case the client is refunded via escrow. On a signed handover certificate, it's clean: the work is done, the money is released, your commission is due.
faq.q4: What happens if I stop publishing?
faq.a4: Don't worry. If more than 7 days go by without proof of content, you receive a warning. After 14 days, your affiliate link is deactivated. All referrals already tied to your account keep generating commissions normally. You can reactivate your link at any time by resuming activity.
faq.q5: What if the person I referred takes time to take action?
faq.a5: You have 15 days after the first click for the conversion to be attributed to your link via the cookie. This duration is intentionally short to encourage you to publish regularly. The cookie renews with every new click from a visitor via your link. Good news: your referral is also tied to your partner account at signup, so we can keep paying you for the 12 months following (3 months for any referred professional).
faq.q6: Can I combine this program with other affiliations?
faq.a6: Yes, no problem. The only case where we cut the link is if you simultaneously recommend a direct competitor of Artisan Compétent (another platform with escrow).
faq.q7: Can I refer my own clients or friends?
faq.a7: Yes, as long as the person you refer actually uses the platform for a real job. Referring close contacts without a real project is considered cookie fraud and triggers suspension.
faq.a8: You enter your IBAN in your partner dashboard. Payment is automatic by bank transfer every quarter. A PDF receipt is generated and downloadable from your dashboard.
faq.q9: What do I have to declare for taxes?
faq.a9: Commissions are income to be declared. Depending on your status, the tax regime differs. Artisan Compétent provides an annual summary of amounts paid. We recommend consulting a tax advisor if you exceed €2,000 in commissions per year.
